blockingIssues.description: emailDispatch is still spawned without the explicit restart supervisor required for critical actors, so VAL-AS-004 is not fully satisfied.

Deprecated `sync.Map` / `nodeRuntimeRegistry` identifiers remain in a comment in backend/janus-api/internal/actors/dependencies.go, so the contracted zero-match grep evidence for VAL-AS-008 still fails.
The scheduled email retry path uses fire-and-forget self-messages, which drop the original Ask reply context and can make retrying email sends time out even after a later success.

Port-collision retry only recognizes the Linux-style `address already in use` string; on this Windows mission host it can miss bind conflicts and fail instead of bumping ports, so VAL-AS-016 is not reliable.
Runner heartbeat coverage only proves that a heartbeat call happened and does not verify persisted `status` / `last_seen_at` behavior required by VAL-AS-013.
Runner listing coverage only checks HTTP 200 and array length, not the required `id`, `status`, and `lastSeenAt` response fields and semantics for VAL-AS-019.
ReadyChecks happy-path coverage omits the `discovery` assertion even though `Node.ReadyChecks()` reports it, so VAL-AS-014 is not fully verified.
The operation lifecycle suite does not cover invalid transitions being rejected, leaving the full VAL-AS-010 state-machine contract unproven.

appliedUpdates.description: Added a GoAkt scheduling note to .factory/library/architecture.md documenting that scheduled self-messages do not preserve Ask reply context.
Added a Windows-specific bind-conflict note to .factory/library/environment.md so future port-collision handling recognizes the host's socket error wording.
Added a scrutiny validation note to .factory/library/user-testing.md that literal grep assertions also match comments.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: For actor-system features, require behavioral tests that cover retry/reply semantics, lifecycle effects, and response payload contracts; allow workers extending an existing suite to adapt the TDD step toward targeted coverage additions instead of superficial config/construction checks.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: as-message-handling shipped without an Ask+retry regression test, as-grain-lifecycle only added option-count/helper/construction checks, and as-actor-tests missed assertions for heartbeat persistence and runner-list response fields.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: When a feature depends on literal grep evidence or the validation contract is broader than the short feature description, restate that explicitly in the feature spec so workers treat comments/literals and adjacent actor-or-grain coverage as in scope.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: as-dependency-injection failed because deprecated identifiers remained in a comment despite a zero-match grep assertion, and as-message-handling exposed a mismatch between the feature summary and VAL-AS-003's actor-plus-grain wording.

rejectedObservations.observation: Document the new DI pattern together with a singleton-supervision caveat in shared actor docs.
rejectedObservations.reason: ambiguous: the reviewed implementation still has a blocking supervision gap for emailDispatch, so the final guidance is not stable enough to record yet.
